“不麻烦不麻烦，举手之劳而已。跟着胡先生，能有危险？你们稍微等我一下，很快就好。”

汐汐便转身叮嘱身后的伙计，让他们走，自己则留下来，跟着众人一同前往桃源古镇。

李二牛加完油，众人也采购好了干粮和水，汐汐安顿好伙计后，也上了车。越野车再次发动，朝着桃源古镇的方向疾驰而去，有汐汐在身边，不仅多了一个向导，车内的气氛也渐渐轻松了一些，汐汐时不时给众人讲一些水产生意上的趣事，缓解了众人心中的凝重。

夕阳西下，金色的余晖洒在山间的小路上，越野车在山路上缓缓行驶，远处的山峦被染成了金色，景色十分优美，可众人却没有心思欣赏这美景，每个人的心中都清楚，桃源古镇等待他们的，必定是一场凶险的挑战，而那个偏僻的废弃宅院，很有可能隐藏着他们想要找的真相。

越野车在山路上行驶了又一个半天，天色渐渐暗了下来，远处的桃源古镇，在夜色的笼罩下，显得愈发阴森诡异。

与上次众人前来时不同，这次古镇周围的阴邪之气更加浓郁，空气中还夹杂着一丝若有若无的腥气，让人莫名的心悸，连车内的指南针，也开始疯狂转动，发出“嗡嗡”的轻响，显然，他们已经靠近了汐汐所说的那个诡异之地。

“前面就是桃源古镇了，那个废弃的宅院就在古镇的西北角，靠近后山，我们得小心一点，那里的波动比我上次来的时候，好像更强烈了，而且周围的阴邪之气也更重了。”

李二牛点了点头，放慢了车速，小心翼翼地将车停在古镇外围的一片空地上，众人依次下车，胡九郎率先走到前面，目光警惕地观察着古镇的四周，神色严肃地说道：

“大家都小心一点，古镇里荒废已久，杂草丛生，很容易隐藏敌人，尽量不要发出太大的声音，跟紧我不要走散了。”

众人纷纷点头，紧紧跟在胡九郎身后，朝着古镇内部走去。夜色越来越浓，月光透过云层，洒在断壁残垣上，留下斑驳的影子，风吹过杂草，发出“沙沙”的声响，像是有人在暗处低语，透着一股阴森恐怖的气息。

路边的房屋大多已经破败不堪，墙壁斑驳脱落，屋顶的瓦片掉了大半，有的房屋甚至已经坍塌，只剩下半截墙壁，在夜色中显得格外狰狞。

汐汐走在队伍的中间，紧紧跟在杨童身边，神色有些紧张，时不时四处张望，显然对这个地方还是有些忌惮。

"No trouble, no trouble, it's just a piece of cake. Is there any danger if you follow Mr. Hu? Just wait for me, I'll be fine soon."

Xixi turned around and told the guys behind her to let them go, while she stayed and followed everyone to Taoyuan Ancient Town.

After Li Erniu refueled, everyone also purchased dry food and water. After Xixi settled down with the crew, she also got in the car.The off-road vehicle started up again and sped towards the Taoyuan Ancient Town. With Xixi by his side, not only did he have an extra guide, but the atmosphere in the vehicle gradually became more relaxed. From time to time, Xixi told everyone some interesting anecdotes about the aquaculture business, which relieved the tension in everyone's hearts.

As the sun sets, the golden afterglow shines on the mountain roads. Off-road vehicles drive slowly on the mountain roads. The mountains in the distance are dyed golden, and the scenery is very beautiful. However, no one has the intention to appreciate the beautiful scenery. Everyone knows in their hearts that what awaits them in Taoyuan Ancient Town must be a dangerous challenge, and that remote abandoned house is likely to hide the truth they want to find.

The off-road vehicle drove on the mountain road for another half day, and the sky gradually darkened. The Taoyuan Ancient Town in the distance looked increasingly eerie and strange under the cover of night.

Different from the last time when everyone came, this time the sinister atmosphere around the ancient town was more intense, and there was also a hint of fishy smell in the air, which made people feel inexplicably palpitating. Even the compass in the car began to rotate crazily, making a soft "buzzing" sound. Obviously, they had approached the strange place that Xixi mentioned.

"Taoyuan Ancient Town is ahead. The abandoned house is in the northwest corner of the ancient town, close to the back mountain. We have to be careful. The fluctuations there seem to be stronger than the last time I came here, and the evil atmosphere around it is also heavier."

Li Erniu nodded, slowed down, and carefully parked the car in an open space outside the ancient town. Everyone got off the car one by one. Hu Jiulang took the lead and walked to the front, observing the surroundings of the ancient town with vigilant eyes, and said seriously:

"Everyone, please be careful. The ancient town has been abandoned for a long time and is overgrown with weeds. It is easy to hide enemies. Try not to make too much noise. Follow me closely and don't get separated."

Everyone nodded and followed Hu Jiulang closely towards the interior of the ancient town.The night is getting darker and darker, the moonlight shines through the clouds and shines on the broken walls, leaving mottled shadows. The wind blows through the weeds, making a "rustling" sound, like someone whispering in the dark, giving off an eerie and terrifying atmosphere.

Most of the houses on the roadside are dilapidated, with mottled and peeling walls, and most of the roof tiles have fallen off. Some houses have even collapsed, leaving only half of the walls, which look particularly hideous in the night.

Xixi walked in the middle of the team, closely following Yang Tong, looking a little nervous, looking around from time to time, obviously still a little wary of this place.
